rationale: A shows brief, stimulus-linked shifts (touch→lean-in t8–11, food offer→food trough t32–35, startle→withdraw t68–71) but otherwise fixates on the ball then spends long periods standing with attention NONE, even ignoring PRESENT_OBJECT:PLAY_BALL at t44.
